Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, high fidelity DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for the Windows/Linux desktop app "execs", a Team Fortress 2 customization manager. Landscape 3840x2160, four equal 16:9 desktop screen designs in a clean 2x2 arrangement, tiny narrow gutters, no devices or perspective. Show FOUR different pages of ONE coherent design direction. Label outer board only "01 / FOUNDRY — Core". This is a visual overhaul, change layout significantly while preserving meaningful controls.
References 1–4 are current app screenshots, CONTENT evidence only, not the new styling. Preserve real task names and authentic game imagery from references. No giant decorative heroes.
FOUNDRY visual system: all dark, warm graphite #151310, surfaces #211E19 and #2C2821, warm cream #F0E9DB, legible secondary #BCB3A3, kiln orange #D98449 reserved for selected state and primary action. Flat broad planes, deliberate thin dividers, tailored 4px corners, confident Inter typography, strong typographic hierarchy, editorial asymmetric layouts. Subtle TF2 inspiration through warm industrial art direction and decisive silhouettes, not themed game menu. Premium studio tool with high information craft, no bevels/grunge/characters/logos/neon/ornamental textures. Actual task media only.
Shared persistent shell in every view: slim top bar execs wordmark orange dot; "Main" profile selector; right "Launch TF2". Left compact grouped text navigation: Comfig, Binds, Gameplay / HUD, Crosshair, Viewmodels, Sounds / Mods, Files, Launch. Current pane accent marker. Quiet bottom app controls Updates / Help / Settings. Comfortable legible text, not microtype. UI should use most of available space.
TOP LEFT "Comfig": left preset decision grid Ultra/High/Medium selected/Low plus All presets. Right large authentic screenshot from ref1. Below show an accessible module navigation row Graphics / Network / Sound and two real module rows; compact official addons summary. No fake FPS scores.
TOP RIGHT "Binds": action mapping workbench with category tabs Movement / Teamplay / Loadouts. Two neatly aligned groups of action-key rows with keycaps W A S D Space Ctrl Mouse1 Mouse2. One Jump row recording "Press a key…" and small Escape to cancel hint. No decorative keyboard.
BOTTOM LEFT "Gameplay": prominent World FOV 90 and Viewmodel FOV 70 sliders with typed numeric values, beside a small restrained explanatory field-of-view diagram labelled illustrative. Below Auto reload and Fast weapon switch toggles, advanced disclosure open for Tracers / Flip viewmodels / Transparent viewmodels (addon). Spacious but not barren.
BOTTOM RIGHT "HUD": catalog-first page, compact installed rayshud strip, Browse / Installed tabs, search, sort A to Z / Updated / Downloads / Views. Six authentic HUD image thumbnails with names rayshud, ToonHUD, budhud, flawhud, m0rehud, hypnotize hud; first-party screenshot references indicate visual content. One selected card and numbered pagination 1 2 3. Import HUD top right. Source/coverage text understated but readable. No inventing download counts.
Must render four complete distinguishable app windows, each with the same exact shell and design language. Crisp readable main labels, professional spacing, rich restrained surface depth, no marketing copy. Make the 4-screen board feel like a finished AAA studio product design presentation.

Use case: ui-mockup. Make a high-fidelity visual redesign board for execs, premium TF2 customization desktop app. Landscape3840x2160, four complete 16:9 screens in2x2, thin gutters. Label outside windows "01 / FOUNDRY — Customization". Reference1 is the accepted visual style anchor: match its typography, shell, palette, component details consistently. References2–5 are actual CURRENT app content, not style. These are visual concepts, not new game assets.
FOUNDRY: warm graphite #151310, surfaces #211E19/#2C2821, cream #F0E9DB, secondary #BCB3A3, kiln orange #D98449. Editorial strong typography, flat wide sections, quiet thin dividers, tailored 4px corners, asymmetric compositions with large useful previews. Maintain precise original Foundry shell from image1.
Shared compact execs header with Main profile menu and Launch TF2, grouped full text left navigation Comfig,Binds,Gameplay / HUD,Crosshair,Viewmodels,Sounds / Mods,Files,Launch. Utilities Updates/Help/App settings. Allow every pane layout to serve its task. Inter type, strong text contrast, clean alignment, sober professional AAA studio craft, authentic quiet TF2 sensibility, no mascot/character wallpaper/hazard stripes/neon/sci-fi/grunge. Selected controls use ring+wash+dot, no checkmarks. Use proper labelled switches and segments rather than native checkboxes or dropdowns when only2–3 choices. Small settings autosave; do not add generic Apply or Save buttons outside explicit heavy actions and Files. Never fabricate metrics, telemetry or progress. Keep game preview illustrative, not a claim of accurate rendered changes.
TOP LEFT Crosshair: full Crosshair page in Custom mode with an open integrated designer. Main preview uses authentic TF2 reference scene with simple white reticle. Compact control stack Name "My crosshair", shape segmented Cross / Dot / Circle, Length 12, Thickness 2, Gap 4, Outline 1, Opacity 100%, Center dot switch. Small thumbnails for other shapes and weapon overrides disclosure. Primary "Build pack" explicit, secondary Cancel for designer. No fake editable game screenshot or unrelated art.
TOP RIGHT HUD Installed: "rayshud" by raysfire, Browse/Installed tabs Installed selected. Large actual game screenshot on the right, all four schema controls on left: Buff color swatch + Opacity100%, Minmode on, Scoreboard Default/Minimal, Ubercharge flash10. Update HUD and Screenshots actions above, Restore stock secondary with confirmation implied. Footer source TF2HUD.Editor. Controls autosave; no Save/Apply button.
BOTTOM LEFT Viewmodels: nine compact class text tabs Scout Soldier(selected) Pyro Demoman Heavy Engineer Medic Sniper Spy. A large labelled illustrative first-person Soldier weapon view on right with a mode selector Show/Hide weapon/Hide all. Left grouped rows Primary/Secondary/Melee and explicit Build pack. Import VPK secondary. Concise "Pack building: Windows" capability note, no false cross-platform parity. No floating untextured 3D weapon.
BOTTOM RIGHT Sounds: two clear Hit and Kill slots across the top, each with assigned name, audition play icon, enabled switch, Volume slider and Boost0/6/12dB segments. Below source tabs Stock / TF2Hitsounds / comfig.app / Yours, search, five named list rows with Play and assign Hit/Kill actions. Real controlled audio list, no decorative waveform. Remove sound files is a quiet explicit action. Keep source credit readable.
Render exactly four full screens; crisp primary labels and controls, no overlapping text, no huge decorative empty header. Match styling of reference1 faithfully while composing these different page tasks thoughtfully.
